text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My first three raucous years with Inari
One are
coming to a close...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her path as a racer stretches
forward
still.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know she has another festival in store,
one that
will move the hearts of many
people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Inari One has brought both Oguri
Cap and
Super Creek to Oi
Racecourse—where her journey
began.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful race. ♪ I was on
the edge of
my seat the entire time!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Right? They totally went all out!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It reminded me of being back in
Kasamatsu.
Makes me want to run on
dirt too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, say no more! How about havin' a
race when
we get back?

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Inari! You came to see us—wait,
huh?!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Y-you brought Oguri Cap and Super
Creek?! The
Eternal Top Three are all
here!

text_block_list.name: Onlookers
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Argh! What're ya doin', sayin' that out
loud!

text_block_list.name: Townswoman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Inari! Are these your friends from
the
academy? Make sure you all come
by my shop
later!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That smell... You must run a soba

restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and it's one of my favorite spots.
The
shrimp tempura she makes is to die
for!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh then we definitely should have a
bite. ♪ I'm
just about hungry myself.

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text:
Inari! Come 'round my shop for round
two! It's on
the house!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, sounds perfect! You're lookin' at
the
hungriest racer in Tracen, right here!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
We should eat at all the restaurants
down this
street.

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text:
I-is she being serious? Better call in the
cavalry
then! We got a hungry beast on
the loose!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Inari, thank you for inviting me out
today. I had a
lot of fun. The food was
delicious too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, glad to hear it. Everyone was
sayin' you
two should come back 'round,
so let's do this
again some time, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'd love that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
By the way... would you like to come
with me to
Kasamatsu? I want to
introduce you to my people
too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! I'd love to see your
hometown!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right, we'll definitely go sometime.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Inari. I can't thank you enough for
today. ♪ I had
so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...After accompanying you, I realized
something.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What's that?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's evident now that your hometown is
the source
of your kindness and
strength. ♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
'Course it is! This workin' class town is
where I got
all my style and class!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with Oguri Cap and
Super
Creek, we head back to my
office...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Boss. I was thinkin' 'bout what
Creek said.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Boss. I was thinkin' 'bout what
Creek said.
choice_data_list: 育った場所がイナリの力の源、って話か？
育った場所がイナリの力の源、って話？

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah.
choice_data_list: 育った場所がイナリの力の源、って話か？
育った場所がイナリの力の源、って話？

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...She's not wrong. But there's somethin'
missin' to
her answer.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's true that the folks back home are the
source
of my strength.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But just as much as they are...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So are you, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So are you, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now and forever... That will never
change.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll still be countin' on ya, partner.
